neighbours.label: a descriptive word right after vocative 'you' (you little …, you poor …, you big …, you lucky …)
fire: Get back here, you little rascal, and finish your soup.
Oh, you poor thing, you must be freezing!
Move over, you big oaf, you are blocking the door.
Won the raffle again, you lucky dog!
Come here, you silly goose, and help me.
Stop that at once, you little monkey!
Well done, you clever girl, you found it.
Look at you, you big softie, crying at a movie.
quiet: Get back here, children, and finish your soup.
Oh, you must be freezing after that long walk!
Move over, please, you are blocking the door.
You won the raffle again this year!
Come here, please, and help me with this.
Stop that at once and go to your room!
Well done, you found it under the sofa.
Look at you, crying at a movie again.

predictions: 7/8 fire; the same sentences without the vocative stay quiet
notes: Card: ' little' x5, ' big' x3, ' lucky', ' poor', ' dip'. Probe: 'you little rookies' 0.87, 'you big fool' 0.96, 'You poor little' 0.66, 'you lucky guy' 0.34; 'come on, kids' 0.02. Rude compounds in the card are not repeated in the test.
